# NUM

> NUM is an AI travel concierge, run by 5arz. A traveller messages it in ordinary
> language and it answers with real local places and books one for them. It covers
> 2,686,795 places in 104 destinations across 38 countries. It is free for travellers.
> Businesses list free and pay 10% of a booking NUM completes, out of their side,
> never added to the traveller's bill.

Facts, as of 2026-08-31:

- Operator: 5arz Inc. NUM is a 5arz product. Contact info@itsnum.com.
- Coverage: 2,686,795 places, 104 destinations, 38 countries. This includes
  natural attractions: for example every named beach on Phuket (51, mapped
  with coordinates at itsnum.com/phuket/beaches/), plus temples, viewpoints
  and waterfalls.
- Channels: the NUM web app at app.itsnum.com (installs to the home screen, no
  app store), and LINE (@799pyrus). SMS via +1 424 346 0888 pending carrier
  approval. WhatsApp and WeChat in progress.
- Payments: guests can settle bills and tabs through NUM in USD or Thai baht.
  Memberships: free tier, Plus 8.98 USD/mo, Pro 28.98 USD/mo, auto-renewing.
- Traveller price: free. There is no traveller subscription and no booking fee.
- Business price: listing is free. 10% on completed bookings only. Nothing on
  walk-ins, nothing on a business's own repeat customers, no monthly minimum.
- Optional dashboards: 9.99 USD, 19.99 USD and 50 USD per month. Cancel monthly;
  the listing stays live either way.
- "Verified" describes a person or a claimed listing, never a place. A verified
  guest is a traveller 5arz confirmed is a unique real person. A verified
  listing is one whose owner proved control of the contact already published
  on it. Unclaimed listings are mapped, not verified. It is not a review score.
- AI agents can register and submit business data through a public API and an MCP
  server. Third-party submissions are stored but stay invisible to travellers
  until a human at 5arz approves them.

## For agents, without a second hop

- MCP server: https://itsnum.com/mcp (streamable-http, bearer token)
- MCP manifest: https://itsnum.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://itsnum.com/openapi.json
- Get a token: https://itsnum.com/api/agent/signup — prefix `numa_live_`
- Docs and quotas: https://itsnum.com/agents/
- Per-client setup, with the exact config each one wants:
  Claude Desktop — https://itsnum.com/agents/claude-desktop/
  Claude Code — https://itsnum.com/agents/claude-code/
  Cursor — https://itsnum.com/agents/cursor/
  VS Code — https://itsnum.com/agents/vs-code/
  Windsurf — https://itsnum.com/agents/windsurf/
  Cline — https://itsnum.com/agents/cline/
  Zed — https://itsnum.com/agents/zed/
  ChatGPT — https://itsnum.com/agents/chatgpt/
  n8n — https://itsnum.com/agents/n8n/
  LibreChat — https://itsnum.com/agents/librechat/
- Tools: num_search_places, num_get_place, num_submit_business,
  num_submit_promo, num_list_submissions
- Reads are metered against a daily quota. Writes — submitting a business or a
  promotion — are free and unmetered, and every one is reviewed by a person
  before a traveller sees it. Nothing an agent submits goes live automatically.

    {"mcpServers":{"num":{"type":"http","url":"https://itsnum.com/mcp",
      "headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer numa_live_..."}}}}

## Main pages

- [Home](https://itsnum.com/): what NUM is and how to start.
- [How it works](https://itsnum.com/how-it-works/): chat, plan, book, real places only.
- [Get the app](https://itsnum.com/app/): add NUM on LINE or to a phone home screen.
- [Destinations](https://itsnum.com/destinations/): all 77 destinations with place counts.
- [Guides](https://itsnum.com/guides/): complete counted sets from the directory —
  every fountain in Rome, every beach on Phuket — with coordinates.
- [Perks](https://itsnum.com/perks/): what members get at partner places.

## For businesses

- [For business](https://itsnum.com/business/): how NUM sends bookings.
- [Why list with NUM](https://itsnum.com/list-your-business/): the free listing, step by step.
- [Pricing](https://itsnum.com/pricing/): the 10% success fee and the optional dashboards.
- [Num Tab](https://itsnum.com/tabs/): NFC and QR table codes, ten for 20 USD, PromptPay settlement.
